analysis.scope: six-hour arrivals, seven-hour cap, seeds 1/2, 10/15/20 per minute; once/sec oracles and two physical restores
analysis.censoring: wait-or-age is observed wait for boarded requests, elapsed age for unboarded requests; not eventual wait
analysis.tail_thresholds: 30/120/300 seconds are descriptive counts, not approved adoption gates

frozen.scope: frozen six-hour arrivals/seven-hour cap, once/sec checks, physical restore3h/6h+dense60s disabled continuation, no sharing or redistribution, virtual4, free-flow; queue1e6 is a comparison admission setting, not live capacity; four one-hour pilots also compare actual production results; no CPU optimization timing claims

continuation.retry_reason: Only two Go test timeouts and four unstarted arms. No assertion retry. Original logs remain in parent directory.

reporting: Mean and p95 include observed boarded waits and unboarded elapsed ages. Completed journey comparisons and exact both-boarded wait comparisons use separate cohorts. 30/120/300s counts are descriptive, not approved adoption limits.
